name: pipeline_rewrite_kickoff
description: Kickoff to scope the ingestion pipeline rewrite with the data platform team: capture current pain, define target architecture and migration plan, assign owners, and confirm next steps.

sections.label: Current pain points
sections.description: Specific performance, reliability, data quality, cost, or operability problems in the existing ingestion pipeline, with examples and impact.

sections.label: Scope and requirements
sections.description: Agreed boundaries and nonfunctional requirements for the rewrite: in-scope/out-of-scope systems, SLAs (latency/throughput), compliance, budgets, and hard constraints.

sections.label: Target architecture
sections.description: Decisions and components of the desired ingestion architecture: patterns (batch/streaming), orchestration, storage, schema/contract management, observability, and tooling.

sections.label: Migration plan and cutover
sections.description: The step-by-step approach to move from current to target, including phases, backfill strategy, parallel run, data validation, and cutover criteria.

sections.label: Risks and assumptions
sections.description: Known risks and open assumptions for the rewrite or migration, with proposed mitigations or validation steps.

sections.label: Workstreams and owners
sections.description: Distinct tracks of work (e.g., framework, connectors, infrastructure, monitoring, governance) with a named DRI/owner per track.

sections.label: Timeline and milestones
sections.description: Key dates, sequencing, and dependencies across workstreams, including critical milestones and decision gates.

sections.label: Next steps and action items
sections.description: Concrete follow-ups with owner and due date: decisions to make, docs to produce, spikes/POCs, meetings, and approvals.

sections.label: Other
sections.description: Anything material that doesn't fit a declared section. Prefer declared sections; use this only when nothing else fits.

phases.label: Rapport
phases.goal: Build rapport, confirm objectives, agenda, time, and who is in the room.

phases.label: Orient and scope
phases.goal: Surface current-state pain and clarify what the rewrite must cover; avoid solutioning yet.

phases.label: Design target
phases.goal: Converge on the target ingestion architecture and key design decisions, noting tradeoffs and rationale.

phases.label: Plan migration and risk
phases.goal: Define the migration approach, identify and mitigate risks, and sketch a realistic timeline.

phases.label: Wrap and commitments
phases.goal: Assign owners to workstreams, read back decisions, and lock next steps and dates.
